implementation.summary: Transient GPU scarcity remains queued and wakes through the scheduler condition; admission atomically reserves required VRAM plus configured headroom; reservations release on terminal paths; queue and execution deadlines are independent per task.
implementation.default_topology_policy: single-slot; real concurrency remains explicit opt-in

notes: Reservation accounting is protected by the scheduler condition and is never inferred from model output.
Reservations are released on executor completion, cancellation completion, and thread-start failure.
Queueing does not allocate a worktree or invoke the executor before admission.
No quota, topology, authorization, or production checkout boundary was weakened.
